g.text: View from south looking north · west at left · B1 terminates at T-E · bottom edge at common wall-top datum · column-supported framing
24-in depth and six equal panel bays are drawing assumptions. Panel dimensions are centerline spacing, not clear cabinet openings.
Rectangular central bays require designed moment connections / Vierendeel action; end diagonals alone are not a complete truss design.
B1 bottom edge is at 8 ft 2½ in; its trial top is at 10 ft 2½ in. Loads go to column-supported framing. Roof clearance: about 6′ 4″ above floor, or 5′ 0¾″ above this trial truss.
Member widths, welds, bearing seats, lateral bracing and cabinet loads remain to be designed.
